subject: Turn a shiny app into a desktop application?

messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: Turn a shiny app into a desktop application?
parts: I have a shiny app that I'd like non-R-users can easily run on their computers. I think the easiest approach would probably be hosting the app in the cloud (like shinyapps.io) so the user only need a web browser, but that can have performance limitations (like if you need to process large data sets) and security concerns (even though can be mitigated with account permissions). Another approach would be running the app locally on the user's machine, but in order to make it as painless as possible, it would be best if the app just behaved like a regular standalone desktop application (which runs R and shiny in the background). The application would probably need to have its own browser window to run shiny. Anyone have suggestions on how to achieve this? I think the Rstudio IDE is exactly something like that (ie, a web based app that behaves like a desktop app), so I guess this approach is not totally crazy. Any idea? (even if it's a completely different approach but achieves the same goal of simplifying the user experience.)
